scope.review_focus: Independent verification of source -> real Node replay -> declared transformations and rebuilt artifacts; previously identified integrity counterexamples.

The unchanged build passed and all counterexamples fail outside check_row.

resolved_findings.evidence: Exact fixed manifest/file sets, source validation, rematerialization and full artifact equality reject missing hashes and empty or relabeled candidate files even after rehashing.

verify requires backend and replays its actual exporter, comparing full projection objects including sourceSha256 for all six Node source files. Rehashed projection content or source hash drift is rejected.
Manifest draft flags, model counters and field sets are explicitly checked. Both human_reviewed=true and training_eligible=true are rejected.

limitations: Integrity is relative to the current trusted editable source, wrapper and backend. This is reproducibility checking, not a cryptographic signature against an actor able to rewrite all trusted code/source/evidence.
Independent AI review does not confer human review or automatic training eligibility.
Semantic label review and old-corpus overlap checks remain separate review scopes.
